raw_text: {"competitors":[],"summary":"The document (Broadcom's 10-K) describes competition only in generic category terms — integrated device manufacturers, fabless semiconductor companies, internal resources of large integrated OEMs, and large enterprise software vendors — without naming any specific competing company. Companies that are named, such as TSMC, Amkor, Foxconn, ASE and Siliconware, appear as foundry/assembly suppliers and contract manufacturers, while LSI, SanDisk and Integrated Circuit Systems appear only in executive biographies or historical acquisition context. Therefore no qualifying competitors can be extracted."}
